notes.title: Version 1.1 Available
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

Today is the first major update since the release.
There are some minor bug corrections.
But the major update is the addition of 2 new free levels I'm sure you'll love playing with.
- The first one is called "Pole Position", and as it sounds, you'll have super speed to complete the circuit while killing your enemies.
- The second one is called "Tetris blocks". It's a blast. I don't want to spoil this one, but I'm sure you'll love it.

There's still a lot of content to come.

Stay tuned.
